title: Reworked Terracotta by Cryngel
description: Just reworked terracotta textures. [no updates are planned, only transitions to newer versions]
body:
![visual](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64d931d0aedeab3cb3874b1b8687a9b8fc6a31f0.png)

# About the resource pack:
This resource pack changes the textures of black, white, gray, light gray, light blue, blue, and cyan terracotta, making them more similar to the "original" colors.

It is suitable for those who are tired of the standard terracotta texture.

# Note:
Please do not install this resource pack together with other similar ones to avoid conflicts.
